name: Feel First: Interactive Sensory Musical Experience by ArtBeat - Launch of the Nav Brand- textiles by people with special needs
description: What if you could feel music before you heard it? Join us for Feel First – A Sound Experiment, an interactive, sensory-friendly experience where sound, rhythm and silence become tools to explore emotions, connection and communication. Whether you're a parent, educator, therapist, artist, or simply curious, this immersive session invites you to discover how music can shape the way we feel, connect and respond. Open to people of all ages | Inclusive | Registration not required  The roads leading up to Sabha are undergoing maintenance, please plan to arrive early and avail of public transport. Parking is not available at the venue.

name: Musical Evening with Kayaka - Launch of NAV by Nav Prabhuthi Trust
description: Where 12th-century Vachana poetry meets acoustic soul. 🎸✨   ​To crown the grand launch of NAV by Nav Prabhuthi Trust, join us for an enchanting musical evening featuring Kayaka (Duo)—a soulful project by acclaimed artists MD Pallavi and Bruce Lee Mani.   ​Experience timeless, progressive poetry reimagined through contemporary acoustic arrangements and expressive vocals. It’s an evening celebrating art, purpose, and community! 🌿🎶 The roads leading up to Sabha are undergoing maintenance, please plan to arrive early and avail of public transport. Parking is not available at the venue.
